Agentik daemon for macOS and Windows

Version: @VERSION@

  • agentik-darwin-arm64 - Apple Silicon (M1 and later)
  • agentik-darwin-amd64 - Intel
  • agentik-windows-amd64.exe - Windows 10/11, 64-bit
  • SHA256SUMS - checksums
  • README.txt - how to verify and run

Run uname -m to check: arm64 is Apple Silicon, x86_64 is Intel. Downloading with curl avoids the macOS quarantine prompt:

curl -fLO https://sergey-telpuk.github.io/agentik/downloads/agentik-darwin-arm64
chmod +x agentik-darwin-arm64
./agentik-darwin-arm64 -pair

Windows: verify with certutil -hashfile agentik-windows-amd64.exe SHA256. SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned program: click More info, then Run anyway. The terminal feature is not available on Windows yet.
